title: Mexican Hash Skillet
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Mexican dish featuring a nutty hash crust topped with melted cheese and a sprinkle of feta.

ingredients.name: cheese
ingredients.notes: shredded, preferably a blend of cheddar and Monterey Jack

instructions: In a large oven-safe skillet, cook the hash over medium heat until lightly browned.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10-12 minutes.
Remove the skillet from the oven and top with shredded cheese.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with crumbled feta cheese.
